name: sorceress_generate_speech
description: Convert text to spoken audio (MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD) with a preset or cloned voice, and save the mp3 into the project (default assets/sorceress/audio). Cost: 1 credit per 2,000 characters (min 1), charged only on success. Call sorceress_list_voices first to get a valid voice_id. Waits for completion and returns the saved file path.

voice_id.description: A preset voice id (e.g. "Wise_Woman") or one of the user's cloned voice ids — from sorceress_list_voices.

emotion.description: none | happy | calm | sad | angry | fearful | disgusted | surprised (default none).
